label: VP1853 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a VP1853-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder VP1853__VP1853 custom HMM profile and experimentally linked to reduced bacteriophage plaquing when the cloned Vibrio parahaemolyticus RIMD 2210633 vp1853 cassette is expressed from a VSV105 plasmid.
